name: base_utils
description: Foundation utility module providing common helpers including message-of-the-day management, custom defined types, Puppet functions, custom Facter facts, Bolt tasks and plans, and OS-specific utility package management with Hiera support.

name: profile_app_stack
description: Full-stack Python web application deployment orchestrating Python 3 runtime, PostgreSQL database provisioning, Git repository cloning, virtualenv creation, systemd service management, Gunicorn/Uvicorn worker configuration, and Prometheus monitoring integration.

name: profile_haproxy
description: HAProxy load balancer with 21-level Hiera hierarchy supporting per-node configuration, multi-backend support via deep hash merging, PuppetDB-based dynamic backend discovery, SSL/TLS termination, and session persistence via stick-tables.

name: profile_postgresql
description: PostgreSQL 15 installation and configuration using PGDG official repository with apt module integration for Debian/Ubuntu systems, version pinning, package management, and service orchestration.

name: profile_redis_cluster
description: Redis cluster configuration using puppet-redis module with PuppetDB integration for cluster node discovery, password-protected instances, memory management, and custom Redis configuration templating.

name: profile::base::base
description: Base operating system profile providing common infrastructure services including chrony NTP time synchronization, rsyslog logging service, and base_utils module integration; applied to all node types as foundation layer.

name: profile::app::stack
description: Thin wrapper profile delegating to profile_app_stack module, providing application stack provisioning with environment-based configuration.

name: profile::cache::redis
description: Thin wrapper profile delegating to profile_redis_cluster module for Redis cluster deployment.

name: profile::loadbalancer::haproxy
description: Thin wrapper profile delegating to profile_haproxy module for HAProxy load balancer deployment.

name: role::app_server
description: Application server role composing base profile with HAProxy load balancer, application stack, and Redis cache; represents a complete multi-tier application server node.

name: role::app_stack
description: Application stack role for dedicated application nodes with PostgreSQL database integration, excluding load balancer and cache layers; ensures base profile completes before application provisioning.

name: role::haproxy
description: Dedicated HAProxy load balancer role combining base OS profile with HAProxy configuration; designed for standalone load balancer nodes.

name: role::redis_cluster
description: Dedicated Redis cluster node role combining base profile with Redis cluster configuration.

name: puppetdb_query_stub
description: Development/testing stub for PuppetDB query function that returns empty arrays when PuppetDB is unavailable, enabling local testing without full PuppetDB infrastructure.
